definitions.explanation: Wood that has been processed for use as a building material or in manufacturing. Refers to cut and prepared wood rather than living trees.

examples.japanese: {木材|もくざい}を{輸入|ゆにゅう}する。
この{家|いえ}は{国産|こくさん}の{木材|もくざい}で{建|た}てられた。
examples.english: This house was built with domestic timber.

examples.japanese: {違法|いほう}な{森林|しんりん}{伐採|ばっさい}による{木材|もくざい}の{輸出|ゆしゅつ}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: The export of timber from illegal logging has become a problem.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers specifically to processed wood used as material. For trees as living plants, use {木|き}. For wood as a general material concept, {木|き} or {木製|もくせい} (made of wood) may also be used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木材|もくざい}{加工|かこう}: wood processing
- {木材|もくざい}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: timber dealer
- {国産|こくさん}{木材|もくざい}: domestic timber
- {建築|けんちく}{木材|もくざい}: construction lumber
- {木材|もくざい}{価格|かかく}: timber prices
